query: SELECT u.id, u.full_name FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.code = u.role::text AND r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.tenant_id = $1 AND u.is_active AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.id <> $2 AND u.department_ids && $4::uuid[] AND (r.permissions ? $3 OR COALESCE(u.access_matrix->'extra' ? $3, false)) AND NOT COALESCE(u.access_matrix->'denied' ? $3, false) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR u.full_name ILIKE $6) ORDER BY u.full_name LIMIT $5
